takeaways: Poora kaam paanch kadam ka hai: test chuniye, form bhariye, confirmation call, sample, report. Ismein ek bhi kadam ghar se nikalne ka nahi hai.
Darwaze par aapke chaar haq hain — ID card dekhna, panel milaana, rate confirm karna, aur tube par apne saamne naam likhwana. Chaaron poochhne me sankoch ki koi baat nahi.
Sheher me slot chunte waqt traffic ka hisaab lagaiye. Subah 6 se 8 ka pehla slot sabse pakka hai, aur fasting wale test ke liye sabse aasan bhi.
Visit late hone ki sabse badi wajah adhoora pata hai. Flat ho to tower, floor aur flat number — teenon likhiye.
Bujurg din me akele rehte hain to booking me ye likh dijiye, aur confirmation call apne number par karwa lijiye.

sections.heading: Ghar Baithe Blood Test Kaise Karaye Gorakhpur — Paanch Kadam, Bas
sections.lead: Poora tareeka ek nazar me. Ismein ek bhi kadam bahar nikalne ka nahi hai.
blocks: Sabse pehle wo cheez jispar sabse zyada shak hota hai: ghar par sample lene se report par koi farak nahi padta. Machine, method aur reference range wahi rehte hain jo kisi bhi counter par sample dene par hote. Blood aur urine ke saare aam test sirf sample par hote hain — sample kahan se uthaya gaya, isse result nahi badalta. Farak sirf itna hai ki nikalna nahi padta.

list: Test chuniye — service page par test aur package alag-alag card par hain. Doctor ka parcha hai to naam milaane ki zaroorat nahi; uska photo bhej dijiye.
Form bhariye — naam, mobile, pata aur landmark, aur slot. Fasting wale test ke liye subah 6 se 8 ka pehla slot lijiye.
Confirmation call — lagbhag 30 minute me. Isi call par test, slot aur rate teenon confirm ho jaate hain.
Sample — trained phlebotomist ID card ke saath aata hai. Visit lagbhag pandrah minute ki hoti hai. Payment usi waqt, cash ya UPI se.
Report — 24 ghante ke andar PDF, WhatsApp aur email par. Booking ka number ya slip sambhaal lijiye; report usi se judti hai.

note.title: Ghar par kya nahi ho sakta
note.text: X-ray, ultrasound, ECG, CT scan aur MRI machine par hoti hain, sample par nahi — inka koi home option hota hi nahi, aur ye hamari service me shaamil bhi nahi hain. Hamara Gorakhpur me koi walk-in counter bhi nahi hai. Parche par imaging likhi ho to us centre par jaana hi padega; blood aur urine wala hissa ghar se karwa lijiye.

sections.heading: Darwaze Par Aapke Chaar Haq — Ye Chaar Cheezein Zaroor Kijiye
sections.lead: Visit pandrah minute ki hai. Ye chaar cheezein usme se do minute leti hain, aur report ko sahi banati hain.
blocks: Zyadatar log darwaze par kuch nahi poochte — sankoch me, ya ye soch kar ki poochhna theek nahi lagega. Asal me ye chaar cheezein aapka haq hain, aur inhi se report ki sacchai tay hoti hai. Ek baar padh lijiye, phir har visit par aadat ban jaayegi.

Alag test ke liye alag rang ki tube hoti hai, isliye ek se zyada tube bharna bilkul normal hai — ismein ghabraane wali koi baat nahi. Sample lene ke saamaan ke baare me kuch bhi poochhna ho to poochh lijiye; poochhna aapka haq hai aur usse koi bura nahi maanta.

note.title: Sui ke baad do minute daabiye, ragadiye mat
note.text: Rui ko sui wali jagah par seedha daba kar do minute rakhiye aur haath seedha rakhiye. Ragadne se aur haath mod lene se hi zyadatar neel padta hai. Us haath se agle kuch ghante bhaari saamaan mat uthaiye. Neel pad bhi jaaye to wo apne aap kuch dinon me chala jaata hai.

sections.heading: Slot Kaise Chunein — Sheher Ki Traffic Aur Fasting Ka Hisaab
sections.lead: Slot sirf sahulat ka sawaal nahi hai. Fasting wale test me wo report ka hissa hai.
blocks: Fasting sirf kuch test me lagti hai — fasting sugar, lipid profile, aur zyadatar package (kyunki package me ye dono aa jaate hain). HbA1c, TSH, CBC, Vitamin D aur B12 me fasting bilkul nahi lagti. Ghar par sample lene ka sabse bada fayda yahi hai ki fasting todne ke liye kahin jaana nahi padta — sample ke turant baad naashta ho jaata hai.

list: Subah 6 se 8 ka pehla slot lijiye. Do wajah: khaali pet ka waqt sabse kam rehta hai, aur sheher ki traffic us waqt sabse halki hoti hai.
Golghar, Civil Lines aur Medical College Road ki taraf 8 se 11 ke beech sabse zyada jaam rehta hai. Us window se bachiye.
Raat ka khana 9 baje tak kar lijiye — isse 10 se 12 ghante apne aap poore ho jaate hain.
Beech me sirf saada paani. Chai, doodh, biscuit, toffee ya paan — inme se kuch bhi fasting tod deta hai.
Paani peete rahiye. Paani ki kami me nas milna mushkil ho jaata hai, aur haemoglobin, urea tatha creatinine jhoothe taur par badhe hue aate hain.
14 ghante se zyada bhookhe rehna faayda nahi, nuksan karta hai. Zyada fasting achhi report nahi banati.
Niyamit dawa apne aap band mat kijiye — booking ke waqt bata dijiye ki kya-kya chal raha hai.

blocks: OPD ki taareekh saamne hai to slot ka faisla aur bhi seedha ho jaata hai: sample OPD se ek din pehle. Report 24 ghante me aati hai, isliye agli subah PDF haath me hogi.

sections.heading: Flat, Gate Aur Gali — Gorakhpur Me Visit Atakne Ki Asli Wajah
sections.lead: Slot theek hota hai. Atakta pata hai — aur wo aap theek kar sakte hain.
blocks: Der ki zyadatar wajah adhoora pata hoti hai, na slot, na phlebotomist. Gorakhpur me ye dikkat do tarah ki hai, aur dono ka ilaaj alag hai.

list: Purane sheher me — Golghar, Civil Lines, Betiahata — road ka naam bekaar hai kyunki wo lamba hai. Building ka naam, floor, aur sabse paas ki dukaan likhiye.
Naye mohallon me — Taramandal, Mohaddipur, Ramgarh Tal ki taraf — plot number to hai par gali map par nahi hoti. Colony ka poora naam aur ek jaana-pehchana landmark likhiye.
Flat ya apartment me: tower ya block ka naam, floor, aur flat number — teenon. Lift hai ya nahi, ye bhi likh dena kaam ka hai.
Gate par guard hai to unhe pehle se bata dijiye. Ye ek line das minute bachati hai.
Ghar par kutta hai, ya gate din me band rehta hai — likh dijiye. Chhoti baat lagti hai, visit isi par atakti hai.
Do mobile number dijiye, aur ye bhi likhiye ki ghar par kaun milega.

blocks: Ek aur haalat jo is sheher me aam hai: aap hospital ke paas kisi kamre me ya rishtedaar ke yahan ruke hain, kyunki ghar ka koi bhartee hai. Us haalat me wahi pata dijiye jahan aap us subah maujood hain — sthayi ghar ka nahi. Hospital ka gate sabse saaf landmark hota hai. Lekin bhartee mareez ka sample hospital ke andar nahi liya ja sakta; wo wahan ki apni vyavastha ka hissa hai.

sections.heading: Bujurg Din Me Ghar Par Akele Hain — Booking Me Kya Likhein
sections.lead: Sheher me sabse aam mamla yahi hai: mata-pita ghar par, bachche daftar me.
blocks: Gorakhpur me bahut se gharon ka dhaancha ek jaisa hai — bujurg din bhar ghar par, aur bachche daftar ya dukaan par. Sugar aur thyroid ka follow-up har teen mahine par aata hai, aur wahi sabse zyada taala jaata hai. Ghar par sample lene ka poora faayda yahin hai, bashart ki booking me kuch baatein likh di jaayein.

list: Confirmation call kis number par aani chahiye — ye alag se likhiye. Aap daftar me hain to apne number par karwa lijiye, aur ghar ka number alag se dijiye.
Mareez bistar par hai, uth nahi sakta, ya sahara chahiye — ye sabse zaroori jaankari hai, kyunki sample bistar par hi liya jaayega.
Nas patli ho chuki hai ya pehle bhi sui me dikkat aayi hai. Pichhli baar kaunsa haath chala tha, ye yaad ho to bata dijiye.
Khoon patla karne wali dawa chal rahi hai — is haalat me dabav thoda zyada der rakhna padta hai.
Sunayi kam deta hai ya yaadasht ki dikkat hai — ghar ka koi vyakti paas rahe, taaki milaan aur nirdesh dono aasan rahein.
Fasting wala test hai to naashta pehle se bana kar rakhwa dijiye — sample ke turant baad khila dena zaroori hai.

sections.heading: Ek Visit Me Poora Ghar — Aur Bachchon Ka Sample
sections.lead: Ek slot me maa-baap, dada-dadi aur bachche — sabka sample ho jaata hai.
blocks: Ghar me aksar ek se zyada logon ka test bakaya hota hai, aur log inhe alag-alag mahinon me karate hain — purani aadat ki wajah se, jab har test ka matlab ek trip tha. Ghar par sample lene par ye alag-alag karna bemaani hai.

list: Sabki booking ek hi slot me kar dijiye. Ek hi visit me sabka sample ho jaata hai.
Jinke test me fasting nahi lagti, unhe bhookha rakhne ki zaroorat nahi — sirf fasting wale log khaali pet rahein.
Har vyakti ka naam, umar aur test alag likhwaiye. Ghar ke do logon ke naam milte-julte hon to ye aur zaroori hai.
Report har vyakti ki alag PDF me aati hai — ek folder me naam aur taareekh ke saath sambhaal lijiye.

blocks: Bachche ka sample lena aam kaam hai, aur ghar par hone ka sabse bada fayda ye hai ki wo apni jagah par, apne logon ke beech rehta hai. Bachche ko pehle se dara kar mat rakhiye, lekin jhooth bhi mat boliye ki "kuch nahi hoga" — itna kehna kaafi hai ki thodi der ke liye chubhega. Bachcha kisi ki god me ho, lita kar zabardasti pakadne se kaam mushkil hota hai. Khoon bahut kam matra me aur umar ke hisaab se liya jaata hai — ghar sabse zyada ghabrata isi baat par hai, aur zaroorat sabse kam ismein hoti hai. Sui ke baad do minute dabaiye, phir kuch khila dijiye.

note.text: Request booking ke waqt likh li jaati hai aur poori koshish ki jaati hai, lekin iska vaada nahi kiya jaata — jo vaada nibhaya na ja sake, wo darwaze par tootta hai. Ghar ka koi vyakti paas rahe to sample lete waqt aur bhi aasan rehta hai; ye kisi bhi mareez ke liye theek hai.

faqs.question: Gorakhpur me home sample collection ka koi extra charge lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Home collection free hai — na visiting charge, na travel charge. Jo rate service page par test ke card par likha hai wahi dena hota hai, aur wo rate confirmation call par bhi confirm kar diya jaata hai. Payment sample lene ke waqt hota hai, cash ya UPI se. Sample dene se pehle aapko rate pata hona chahiye; na pata ho to poochh lijiye.

faqs.question: Ghar par sample lene wala kaun aata hai, aur use kaise pehchanein?
faqs.answer: Trained phlebotomist aata hai aur uske paas ID card hota hai — maangne me sankoch mat kijiye, dikhana uska kaam hai. Booking ke waqt jo test tay hue the wahi liye jaane chahiye, rate wahi hona chahiye jo bataya gaya tha, aur tube par aapke saamne naam likha jaana chahiye. Ye chaar cheezein aapka haq hain.

faqs.question: Visit me kitna waqt lagta hai?
faqs.answer: Lagbhag pandrah minute, aur usme sui ka hissa sirf do-teen minute ka hota hai. Baaki waqt pehchan, milaan, taiyaari aur label me lagta hai — wahi hissa report ko sahi banata hai. Ghar ke kai log ek saath test kara rahe hain to thoda zyada waqt lagta hai, lekin sabka sample ek hi visit me ho jaata hai.

faqs.question: Flat me rehta hoon — booking me kya likhna chahiye?
faqs.answer: Tower ya block ka naam, floor, aur flat number — teenon. Lift hai ya nahi ye bhi likh dijiye, aur gate par guard ho to unhe pehle se bata dijiye. Naye mohallon me — Taramandal, Mohaddipur ya Ramgarh Tal ki taraf — colony ka poora naam aur ek jaana-pehchana landmark plot number se zyada kaam karta hai.

faqs.question: Mere maa-baap din me ghar par akele rehte hain — booking main kar sakta hoon?
faqs.answer: Haan, aur ye yahan bahut aam hai. Booking me do baatein likh dijiye: confirmation call kis number par aani chahiye (aap daftar me hain to apne number par), aur ghar par kaun milega uska alag number. Mareez bistar par hai, nas patli hai, ya khoon patla karne wali dawa chal rahi hai — ye bhi bata dijiye, taaki aane wala taiyaari ke saath aaye.

faqs.question: Fasting wale test ke liye kaunsa slot lena chahiye?
faqs.answer: Subah 6 se 8 ka pehla slot — do wajah se. Khaali pet ka waqt sabse kam rehta hai, aur sheher ki traffic us waqt sabse halki hoti hai. Raat ka khana 9 baje tak kar lijiye, beech me sirf saada paani, aur naashta taiyaar rakhiye. 14 ghante se zyada bhookhe rehna faayda nahi, nuksan karta hai.

faqs.question: Hospital ke paas ruke hain — wahan sample liya ja sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Agar aap kisi kamre ya rishtedaar ke yahan ruke hain to haan — wahi pata dijiye jahan aap us subah maujood hain, sthayi ghar ka nahi, aur landmark ke taur par hospital ka gate likh dijiye. Lekin hospital me bhartee mareez ka sample is service se nahi liya ja sakta; wo wahan ki apni vyavastha ka hissa hai.

faqs.question: Ek hi visit me ghar ke chaar logon ka test ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Haan. Sabki booking ek hi slot me kar dijiye aur har vyakti ka naam, umar aur test alag likhwaiye. Jinke test me fasting nahi lagti unhe bhookha rakhne ki zaroorat nahi — sirf fasting wale log khaali pet rahein. Report har vyakti ki alag PDF me aati hai.
